import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Resultant.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Prod
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.FiniteDimension

/-! Actual bounded polynomials, endowed with their coefficient norm.
No polynomial, derivative or determinant identity is assumed. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev Coeff (n : ℕ) := Polynomial.degreeLT ℝ n

instance coeffNormedAddCommGroup (n : ℕ) : NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff n) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.induced _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)
    (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective

instance coeffNormedSpace (n : ℕ) : NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff n) :=
  NormedSpace.induced ℝ _ (Fin n → ℝ) (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n)

/-- Retain exactly the coefficients of orders less than `n`. -/
def cut (n : ℕ) : ℝ[X] →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n :=
  (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (LinearMap.pi fun i : Fin n => Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ i)

@[simp] theorem degreeLTEquiv_coeff {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) (i : Fin n) :
    degreeLTEquiv ℝ n p i = (p : ℝ[X]).coeff i := rfl

@[simp] theorem cut_coeff (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ[X]) (i : Fin n) :
    ((cut n p : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = p.coeff i := by
  exact congrFun ((degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).apply_symm_apply (fun j : Fin n => p.coeff j)) i

@[simp] theorem cut_coe {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : cut n (p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  simp

/-- Coefficient truncation of the actual polynomial product, as a bilinear map. -/
def mulLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ ℝ (fun p q => cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])))
    (by intros; simp [add_mul])
    (by intros; simp [smul_mul_assoc])
    (by intros; simp [mul_add])
    (by intros; simp [mul_smul_comm])

def mulCLM (m n r : ℕ) : Coeff m →L[ℝ] Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    ((LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap :
      (Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff r) ≃ₗ[ℝ] (Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff r)).toLinearMap.comp
      (mulLM m n r))

@[simp] theorem mulCLM_apply {m n r : ℕ} (p : Coeff m) (q : Coeff n) :
    mulCLM m n r p q = cut r ((p : ℝ[X]) * (q : ℝ[X])) := rfl

/-- The linear inclusion of a polynomial of degree `< n` into degree `< n+1`. -/
def liftLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  (cut (n+1)).comp (degreeLT ℝ n).subtype

def liftCLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff n →L[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (liftLM n)

lemma coeff_eq_zero_of_bound {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) {k : ℕ} (hk : n ≤ k) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).coeff k = 0 := by
  exact Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt
    ((Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hk))

@[simp] theorem coe_lift {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (liftCLM n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  by_cases hk : k < n+1
  · exact cut_coeff (n+1) (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,hk⟩
  · rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hk),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

def topMonomial (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  ⟨X^n, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr (by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_X_pow]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)⟩

def monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : Coeff (n+1) :=
  topMonomial n + liftCLM n p

@[simp] theorem coe_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]) = X^n + (p : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [monicPoly, topMonomial]

lemma bounded_natDegree {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro k hk
  exact coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)

/-- The affine monic-coordinate map has the actual Frechet derivative equal
    to its coefficient inclusion, including the degree-zero case. -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicPoly (liftCLM n) p := by
  exact (liftCLM n).hasFDerivAt.const_add (topMonomial n)

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/BlockJacobian.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree
open Module

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

/-- The derivative block occurring in polynomial numerator/denominator gluing. -/
def repeatedBlock (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E × E) →L[ℝ] (F × F) :=
  (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E)).prod
    (C.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E E) +
      L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E E))

@[simp] theorem repeatedBlock_apply (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E × E) :
    repeatedBlock L C x = (L x.1, C x.1 + L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF) (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) 0
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF C.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;> simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, repeatedBlock]

/-- An exact determinant theorem: no nonsingularity assumptions on either block. -/
theorem det_repeatedBlock {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F) (L C : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.prod bE) (bF.prod bF)
      (repeatedBlock L C).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det ^ 2 := by
  rw [toMatrix_repeatedBlock, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂, pow_two]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/Gluing.lean:
import HydrologyTree.BlockJacobian

/-! Actual polynomial coefficient gluing and its actual Frechet derivative. -/
open Polynomial
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

abbrev PolyPair (m n : ℕ) := Coeff m × Coeff n
abbrev GlueInput (m n : ℕ) := PolyPair m n × PolyPair m n

def pairBasis (m n : ℕ) : Module.Basis (Fin (m+n)) ℝ (PolyPair m n) :=
  ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

lemma coeff_natDegree_le {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (p : ℝ[X]).natDegree ≤ n := by
  simpa using bounded_natDegree (liftCLM n p)

def sylvCLM {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X]) (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) :
    PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (sylvesterMap f g hf hg)

@[simp] theorem sylvCLM_cut {m n : ℕ} (f g : ℝ[X])
    (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n) (x : PolyPair m n) :
    sylvCLM f g hf hg x = cut (m+n) (f * (x.2 : ℝ[X]) + g * (x.1 : ℝ[X])) := by
  exact (cut_coe (sylvesterMap f g hf hg x)).symm

def monoSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)
    (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _)

def lowSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] Coeff (m+n) :=
  sylvCLM x.1 x.2 (coeff_natDegree_le _) (coeff_natDegree_le _)

/-- The non-leading coefficients of `U*V`, and all coefficients of `R*V+U*S`.
Here U and V are actual monic polynomials with the supplied low coefficients;
R and S have arbitrary coefficients of degrees below m and n. -/
def glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n) :=
  (mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2),
   mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n) x.2.1 (monicPoly x.1.2) +
     mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n) (monicPoly x.1.1) x.2.2)

/-- The complete derivative, including the off-diagonal numerator terms. -/
def glueDerivative {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] (Coeff (m+n) × Coeff (m+n)) :=
  repeatedBlock (monoSylv x.1) (lowSylv x.2)

set_option maxHeartbeats 600000 in
theorem hasFDerivAt_glue {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    HasFDerivAt glue (glueDerivative x) x := by
  let A : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let B : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let R : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff m :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  let S : GlueInput m n →L[ℝ] Coeff n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (Coeff n)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (PolyPair m n) (PolyPair m n))
  have ha := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (A x)).comp x A.hasFDerivAt
  have hb := (hasFDerivAt_monicPoly (B x)).comp x B.hasFDerivAt
  have hp := ((mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply hb
  have hr := ((mulCLM m (n+1) (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x R.hasFDerivAt).clm_apply hb
  have hs := ((mulCLM (m+1) n (m+n)).hasFDerivAt.comp x ha).clm_apply S.hasFDerivAt
  apply (hp.prodMk (hr.add hs)).congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  apply Prod.ext
  all_goals
    simp only [glueDerivative, repeatedBlock_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
      Function.comp_apply, A, B, R, S,
      monoSylv, lowSylv, sylvCLM_cut,
      mulCLM_apply, coe_lift]
  · change cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X])) =
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X]))
    rw [map_add, mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
  · change (cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]))) +
      (cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X])) +
        cut (m+n) ((h.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]))) =
      cut (m+n) ((x.2.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (x.2.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])) +
      cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1.1 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.2 : ℝ[X]) +
        (monicPoly x.1.2 : ℝ[X]) * (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]))
    simp only [map_add]
    rw [mul_comm (h.2.1 : ℝ[X]), mul_comm (h.1.1 : ℝ[X])]
    abel

/-- The Jacobian of the actual real coefficient map, in specified coefficient bases. -/
def gluingJacobian {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((pairBasis m n).prod (pairBasis m n))
    ((degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n)))
    (fderiv ℝ glue x).toLinearMap).det

/-- The two-polynomial gluing formula for every degree, every numerator and
all coefficients. Common roots and zero resultant are included. -/
theorem gluingJacobian_eq_resultant_sq {m n : ℕ} (x : GlueInput m n) :
    gluingJacobian x =
      Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2) m n ^ 2 := by
  rw [gluingJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_glue x).fderiv]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix _ _ (repeatedBlock _ _).toLinearMap).det = _
  rw [det_repeatedBlock]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (sylvesterMap (monicPoly x.1.1) (monicPoly x.1.2)
      (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _))).det ^ 2 = _
  rw [pairBasis, Polynomial.toMatrix_sylvesterMap']
  rfl

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/LeadingCoefficients.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Coefficients

/-! Leading-coefficient charts for the actual bounded polynomial spaces. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

lemma monic_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) : (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).Monic := by
  rw [coe_monicPoly]
  exact Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add (Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mp p.property)

@[simp] lemma monicPoly_coeff_top {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).coeff n = 1 := by
  simp [coe_monicPoly, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p le_rfl]

@[simp] lemma natDegree_monicPoly {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    (monicPoly p : ℝ[X]).natDegree = n := by
  apply le_antisymm (bounded_natDegree _)
  exact Polynomial.le_natDegree_of_ne_zero (by
    rw [monicPoly_coeff_top]
    exact one_ne_zero)

lemma cut_X_pow_of_le (n k : ℕ) (hnk : n ≤ k) : cut n (X^k) = 0 := by
  apply (degreeLTEquiv ℝ n).injective
  funext i
  change ((cut n (X^k) : Coeff n) : ℝ[X]).coeff i = 0
  rw [cut_coeff]
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, show (i : ℕ) ≠ k from by omega]

/-- Assemble a leading coefficient and all lower coefficients, without division. -/
def joinLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) where
  toFun x := x.1 • topMonomial n + liftCLM n x.2
  map_add' x y := by simp [add_smul]; abel
  map_smul' c x := by simp [smul_add, smul_smul]

@[simp] lemma coe_joinLeadingLM {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    (joinLeadingLM n x : ℝ[X]) = x.1 • (X^n : ℝ[X]) + (x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  simp [joinLeadingLM, topMonomial]

/-- Split a bounded polynomial into its leading coefficient and its truncation. -/
def splitLeadingLM (n : ℕ) : Coeff (n+1) →ₗ[ℝ] (ℝ × Coeff n) :=
  ((Polynomial.lcoeff ℝ n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype).prod
    ((cut n).comp (degreeLT ℝ (n+1)).subtype)

@[simp] lemma splitLeadingLM_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    splitLeadingLM n p = ((p : ℝ[X]).coeff n, cut n (p : ℝ[X])) := rfl

lemma split_joinLeading {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    splitLeadingLM n (joinLeadingLM n x) = x := by
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound x.2 le_rfl]
  · simp [coe_joinLeadingLM, cut_X_pow_of_le n n le_rfl]

lemma join_splitLeading {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    joinLeadingLM n (splitLeadingLM n p) = p := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_joinLeadingLM]
  ext k
  simp only [splitLeadingLM_apply, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_smul,
    smul_eq_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with h | h | h
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt h), mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n (p : ℝ[X]) ⟨k,h⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, mul_one, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt h), mul_zero,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ h.le, zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound p (by omega)]

/-- The exact linear isomorphism between high-first and ordinary polynomial coefficients. -/
def leadingEquiv (n : ℕ) : (ℝ × Coeff n) ≃ₗ[ℝ] Coeff (n+1) :=
  { joinLeadingLM n with
    invFun := splitLeadingLM n
    left_inv := split_joinLeading
    right_inv := join_splitLeading }

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (x : ℝ × Coeff n) :
    leadingEquiv n x = joinLeadingLM n x := rfl

@[simp] lemma leadingEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff (n+1)) :
    (leadingEquiv n).symm p = splitLeadingLM n p := rfl

lemma monicPoly_eq_leadingEquiv {n : ℕ} (p : Coeff n) :
    monicPoly p = leadingEquiv n (1,p) := by
  simp [monicPoly, leadingEquiv, joinLeadingLM]

/-- Leading degree first, then increasing lower degrees. -/
def leadingBasis (n : ℕ) : Basis (Unit ⊕ Fin n) ℝ (Coeff (n+1)) :=
  ((Basis.singleton Unit ℝ).prod (degreeLT.basis ℝ n)).map (leadingEquiv n)

/-- Truncation is exact whenever the original polynomial already satisfies the bound. -/
lemma coe_cut_of_degree_lt {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.degree < n) :
    (cut n p : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  let q : Coeff n := ⟨p, Polynomial.mem_degreeLT.mpr hp⟩
  exact congrArg (fun z : Coeff n => (z : ℝ[X])) (cut_coe q)

/-- Actual monic polynomials are recovered from their non-leading coefficients. -/
lemma monic_reconstruct {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ[X]) (hp : p.Monic) (hd : p.natDegree = n) :
    (monicPoly (cut n p) : ℝ[X]) = p := by
  ext k
  rw [coe_monicPoly, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow]
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with hk | hk | hk
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_lt hk), zero_add]
    exact cut_coeff n p ⟨k,hk⟩
  · subst k
    rw [if_pos rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ le_rfl, add_zero]
    rw [← hd, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, hp]
  · rw [if_neg (ne_of_gt hk), zero_add,
      coeff_eq_zero_of_bound _ hk.le,
      Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/ProductDerivative.lean:
import HydrologyTree.Gluing
import HydrologyTree.LeadingCoefficients

/-! Multiplication of actual monic coefficient vectors. This supplies the
one-copy Sylvester derivative needed in the arbitrary-child induction. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

def monicMultiply {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : Coeff (m+n) :=
  mulCLM (m+1) (n+1) (m+n) (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)

lemma monicMultiply_eq_cut {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    monicMultiply x = cut (m+n) ((monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.2 : ℝ[X])) := rfl

theorem hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    HasFDerivAt monicMultiply (monoSylv x) x := by
  let ins : PolyPair m n →L[ℝ] GlueInput m n :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (PolyPair m n)).prod 0
  have h := ((hasFDerivAt_glue (ins x)).comp x ins.hasFDerivAt).fst
  apply h.congr_fderiv
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro z
  rfl

def monicMultiplyJacobian {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (fderiv ℝ monicMultiply x).toLinearMap).det

theorem monicMultiplyJacobian_eq {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    monicMultiplyJacobian x =
      Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2) m n := by
  rw [monicMultiplyJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply x).fderiv]
  change (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
    (sylvesterMap (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2)
      (bounded_natDegree _) (bounded_natDegree _))).det = _
  rw [pairBasis, Polynomial.toMatrix_sylvesterMap']
  rfl

theorem monicMultiply_reconstruct {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    (monicPoly (monicMultiply x) : ℝ[X]) =
      (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) * (monicPoly x.2 : ℝ[X]) := by
  rw [monicMultiply_eq_cut]
  apply monic_reconstruct
  · exact (monic_monicPoly x.1).mul (monic_monicPoly x.2)
  · rw [Polynomial.natDegree_mul (monic_monicPoly x.1).ne_zero (monic_monicPoly x.2).ne_zero,
      natDegree_monicPoly, natDegree_monicPoly]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/JacobianComposition.lean:
import HydrologyTree.ProductDerivative

/-! Basis-aware determinant composition for growing coefficient families. -/
open Matrix Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

section Linear
variable {E₀ E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E₀] [NormedSpace ℝ E₀]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def keepLeft (L : E →L[ℝ] F) : (E₀ × E) →L[ℝ] (E₀ × F) :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ E₀ E).prod (L.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ E₀ E))

@[simp] lemma keepLeft_apply (L : E →L[ℝ] F) (x : E₀ × E) :
    keepLeft L x = (x.1, L x.2) := rfl

lemma toMatrix_keepLeft {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (b₀ : Basis ι ℝ E₀) (bE : Basis κ ℝ E)
    (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (b₀.prod bE) (b₀.prod bF) (keepLeft L).toLinearMap =
      Matrix.fromBlocks (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) 0 0 (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap) := by
  ext i j
  cases i <;> cases j <;>
    simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, keepLeft, Matrix.one_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

lemma det_keepLeft {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (b₀ : Basis ι ℝ E₀) (bE : Basis κ ℝ E)
    (bF : Basis κ ℝ F) (L : E →L[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (b₀.prod bE) (b₀.prod bF) (keepLeft L).toLinearMap).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L.toLinearMap).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_keepLeft, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₁₂]
  simp

lemma toMatrix_both_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.reindex e) (bF.reindex e) L =
      Matrix.reindex e e (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L) := by
  ext i j
  simp [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Matrix.reindex_apply]

lemma det_both_reindex {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (bE : Basis ι ℝ E) (bF : Basis ι ℝ F)
    (e : ι ≃ κ) (L : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (bE.reindex e) (bF.reindex e) L).det =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix bE bF L).det := by
  rw [toMatrix_both_reindex, Matrix.det_reindex_self]

end Linear
end HydrologyTree

import HydrologyTree.JacobianComposition

/-! Actual multiplication of arbitrarily many monic factors and its full
Fréchet Jacobian, with every degree and coefficient value allowed. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

@[reducible] def ProductInput : List ℕ → Type
  | [] => Coeff 0
  | m :: ms => Coeff m × ProductInput ms

instance productInputNormed : (ms : List ℕ) → NormedAddCommGroup (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by
    letI := productInputNormed ms
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedAddCommGroup (Coeff m × ProductInput ms))

instance productInputNormedSpace : (ms : List ℕ) → NormedSpace ℝ (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff 0))
  | m :: ms => by
    letI := productInputNormedSpace ms
    exact inferInstanceAs (NormedSpace ℝ (Coeff m × ProductInput ms))

def familyBasis : (ms : List ℕ) → Basis (Fin ms.sum) ℝ (ProductInput ms)
  | [] => degreeLT.basis ℝ 0
  | m :: ms => ((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv

/-- Low coefficients of the true product of all monic input polynomials. -/
def familyProduct : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → Coeff ms.sum
  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x => monicMultiply (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)

def familyProductDerivative : (ms : List ℕ) → (x : ProductInput ms) →
    ProductInput ms →L[ℝ] Coeff ms.sum
  | [], _ => 0
  | m :: ms, x =>
    (monoSylv (x.1, familyProduct ms x.2)).comp
      (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2))

theorem hasFDerivAt_familyProduct (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    HasFDerivAt (familyProduct ms) (familyProductDerivative ms x) x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => exact hasFDerivAt_const (0 : Coeff 0) x
  | cons m ms ih =>
    have hfst := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
    have hsnd := (ih x.2).comp x
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ (Coeff m) (ProductInput ms)).hasFDerivAt
    exact (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).comp x (hfst.prodMk hsnd)

/-- All individual factors as actual polynomials, retaining possible repetitions. -/
def familyPolynomials : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → List ℝ[X]
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: ms, x => (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]) :: familyPolynomials ms x.2

theorem familyProduct_reconstruct (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x) : ℝ[X]) = (familyPolynomials ms x).prod := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (monicPoly (0 : Coeff 0) : ℝ[X]) = 1
    simp [coe_monicPoly]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (monicPoly (monicMultiply (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)) : ℝ[X]) = _
    rw [monicMultiply_reconstruct, ih]
    rfl

/-- Resultant product in recursive factor-versus-remaining-product form. -/
def familyResultant : (ms : List ℕ) → ProductInput ms → ℝ
  | [], _ => 1
  | m :: ms, x =>
    Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x.2)) m ms.sum *
      familyResultant ms x.2

lemma det_monoSylv {m n : ℕ} (x : PolyPair m n) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (pairBasis m n) (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+n))
      (monoSylv x).toLinearMap).det =
        Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly x.2) m n := by
  simpa only [monicMultiplyJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_monicMultiply x).fderiv] using
    monicMultiplyJacobian_eq x

theorem det_familyProductDerivative (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
      (familyProductDerivative ms x).toLinearMap).det = familyResultant ms x := by
  induction ms with
  | nil =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0) (degreeLT.basis ℝ 0)
      (0 : Coeff 0 →ₗ[ℝ] Coeff 0)).det = 1
    simp
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change (LinearMap.toMatrix (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum))
      ((monoSylv (x.1,familyProduct ms x.2)).toLinearMap.comp
        (keepLeft (E₀ := Coeff m) (familyProductDerivative ms x.2)).toLinearMap)).det =
      _ * familyResultant ms x.2
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_comp
      (((degreeLT.basis ℝ m).prod (familyBasis ms)).reindex finSumFinEquiv) (pairBasis m ms.sum)
      (degreeLT.basis ℝ (m+ms.sum)), Matrix.det_mul, det_monoSylv]
    congr 1
    rw [pairBasis, det_both_reindex, det_keepLeft, ih]

/-- The determinant is taken from fderiv of the actual coefficient map. -/
def familyProductJacobian (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) : ℝ :=
  (LinearMap.toMatrix (familyBasis ms) (degreeLT.basis ℝ ms.sum)
    (fderiv ℝ (familyProduct ms) x).toLinearMap).det

theorem familyProductJacobian_eq (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = familyResultant ms x := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian, (hasFDerivAt_familyProduct ms x).fderiv,
    det_familyProductDerivative]

end HydrologyTree
files.HydrologyTree/FamilyResultants.lean:
import HydrologyTree.FamilyProduct

/-! Exact pairwise resultant expansion of the arbitrary-family product Jacobian. -/
open Polynomial Module
noncomputable section
namespace HydrologyTree

/-- One factor for every ordered-by-position pair i<j, repetitions allowed. -/
def pairwiseResultants : List ℝ[X] → ℝ
  | [] => 1
  | p :: ps => (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants ps

lemma familyPolynomials_degree_sum (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ((familyPolynomials ms x).map Polynomial.natDegree).sum = ms.sum := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih => simp [familyPolynomials, natDegree_monicPoly, ih]

lemma familyPolynomials_monic (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    ∀ p ∈ familyPolynomials ms x, p.Monic := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => simp [familyPolynomials]
  | cons m ms ih =>
    intro p hp
    simp only [familyPolynomials, List.mem_cons] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | hp
    · exact monic_monicPoly _
    · exact ih _ p hp

lemma monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) : ps.prod.Monic := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => exact Polynomial.monic_one
  | cons p ps ih =>
    exact (hs p (by simp)).mul (ih (fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])))

lemma natDegree_monic_list_prod (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Monic) :
    ps.prod.natDegree = (ps.map Polynomial.natDegree).sum := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    have hp := hs p (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic := fun q hq => hs q (by simp [hq])
    rw [List.prod_cons, Polynomial.natDegree_mul hp.ne_zero (monic_list_prod ps ht).ne_zero,
      ih ht]
    rfl

lemma resultant_list_prod (p : ℝ[X]) (ps : List ℝ[X]) (hs : ∀ q ∈ ps, q.Monic) :
    p.resultant ps.prod = (ps.map fun q => p.resultant q).prod := by
  induction ps with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have hq := hs q (by simp)
    have ht : ∀ r ∈ qs, r.Monic := fun r hr => hs r (by simp [hr])
    rw [List.prod_cons,
      Polynomial.natDegree_mul hq.ne_zero (monic_list_prod qs ht).ne_zero,
      Polynomial.resultant_mul_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl, ih ht]
    rfl

/-- The recursive derivative determinant is exactly the product over all pairs. -/
theorem familyResultant_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyResultant ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  induction ms with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons m ms ih =>
    change Polynomial.resultant (monicPoly x.1) (monicPoly (familyProduct ms x.2)) m ms.sum *
        familyResultant ms x.2 = _
    rw [ih]
    change _ = ((familyPolynomials ms x.2).map fun q =>
      (monicPoly x.1 : ℝ[X]).resultant q).prod * pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
    congr 1
    have h := resultant_list_prod (monicPoly x.1) (familyPolynomials ms x.2)
      (familyPolynomials_monic ms x.2)
    rw [← familyProduct_reconstruct] at h
    simpa only [natDegree_monicPoly] using h

/-- Full all-degree, all-coefficient product-Jacobian formula in pairwise form. -/
theorem familyProductJacobian_eq_pairwise (ms : List ℕ) (x : ProductInput ms) :
    familyProductJacobian ms x = pairwiseResultants (familyPolynomials ms x) := by
  rw [familyProductJacobian_eq, familyResultant_eq_pairwise]

end HydrologyTree
